question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugin.approval.cancel` plus nullable `plugin.approval.resolved.decision` as the permanent plugin approval cancellation contract for SDK/channel consumers?
rationale: The code change is a bug fix, but it changes public gateway/plugin approval semantics and currently covers only part of the approval-waiter surface, so maintainer intent is needed for the API shape before merge.

options.title: Complete and document the cancel contract
options.body: Require all abort-aware waiters to call the same cancel path and add focused compatibility tests or docs for nullable plugin resolved events before merge.

options.title: Land a narrower internal-only repair
options.body: Keep cancellation scoped to internal requesters and avoid widening public plugin resolved payloads until maintainers choose an SDK contract.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold this PR until the plugin approval API direction is settled and a narrower follow-up can implement the chosen contract.

recommendation.title: Complete and document the cancel contract
recommendation.body: Require all abort-aware waiters to call the same cancel path and add focused compatibility tests or docs for nullable plugin resolved events before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this handle to plugin approval merge/routing hardening and this decision is about the gateway/plugin approval contract.
